verdict.rationale: All evidence shows the SDK is built specifically around Claude Code, bundling and spawning a 'claude CLI' subprocess and Claude-specific session/tool architecture; nothing in the docs or community evidence indicates support for swapping to a different LLM provider or model family without rewriting agent code. The tight coupling to the Claude CLI subprocess (claude-agent-sdk-docs-20, claude-agent-sdk-gh-1) suggests the opposite of provider portability.
